parameters.name: DatabaseAccountName
parameters.description: The name of the database account to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: DatabaseId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the database for which you want to create an account.
> You can invoke the [ListDatabaseAccounts](~~2758839~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: DatabaseSchema
parameters.description: The database name. This parameter is required when the database corresponding to DatabaseId is PostgreSQL or Oracle.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance for which you want to create a database account.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: LoginAttribute
parameters.description:
The logon attribute. This parameter is required for Oracle databases. Valid values:
- SERVICENAME
- SID

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the database account to create.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a database account.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
